messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock SLA gating & staging cut for Trench pilot. Customer legal deadline: Apr 12. Can runtime/infra confirm capacity & fallback plan? :calendar:

Ethan (Eng): FYI I blocked time to spec traffic patterns. Need to know target RPS and 95p latency SLO to size.

Marta (Runtime): @Ethan rough target from bench: 500 RPS peak, 95p < 220ms on dedicated. Need model variant v2-quant for cost. Also prefix caching should be enabled for prewarm.

Sam (Infra): We can reserve 2 node-pools in staging (g4dn-equivalent). Need estimates for GPU-hours per day.

Priya (PM): Customer expects 24/7 pilot for 2 weeks. Target sustained 200 RPS, bursts to 500. Budget constraint: prefer < $X/day — will clarify.

Riley (Security): Sending HSM/KMS checklist. If customer requires HSM, private deploy timelines +2w. Also need threat model sign-off.

Juno (SRE): We should add circuit-breaker: fallback to smaller model + rate-limiter. Also create synthetic workload for smoke tests.

Priya (PM): Action items: 1) Runtime: confirm model variant + caching flags by EOD. 2) Infra: GPU-hours estimate + reservation by tomorrow. 3) Security: HSM impact and sign-off ETA. 4) Eng: implement graceful fallback. Anyone want to add?

Ethan (Eng): I'll do fallback + smoke harness. ETA 48h.

Marta (Runtime): Confirmed: v2-quant + prefix cache on. Perf matrix attached (summary below).

Marta (Runtime): ```json
{"rollout":"canary","percent":10,"fallback":"v1"}
```

Sam (Infra): GPU-hours rough calc: (200 sustained + bursts) ~ 180 GPU-hours/day. Reserving 2 nodes gives ~96 GPU-hours/day; need 3 nodes. Will open infra ticket INF-4321.

Juno (SRE): infra ticket noted. Add alerting runbook: token-cost spike, tail-latency increase, OOM on kv-cache.

Riley (Security): HSM adds 10 business days + SOC review. If customer can accept KMS only, we can be faster.

Priya (PM): Decision needed: HSM required? @customer-ops to confirm. Meanwhile proceed with KMS path as plan B.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4321, assigned to Sam. Deployed staging cluster snapshot at 1793456900.

Ethan (Eng): Quick note — tests might need updated golden prompts for quality regression checks.

Priya (PM): Thanks. We'll reconvene tomorrow same time. Closing with owners: Priya (PM) owner, Marta (Runtime) perf, Sam (Infra) capacity, Riley (Security) compliance, Ethan (Eng) fallback. :white_check_mark:
